chapter: Manly Jack's Manly Journey of Manliness

quests.title: Manly Jack's Manly Journey of Manliness

dialogue.t: I guess you saw that commission, huh? Nice! Now, do you have three servings of Mondstadt Grilled Fish for me?
Wow, these Mondstadt Grilled Fishes smell pretty good...
Oh, yeah. Here's something to thank you for your help.
Will this stuff make me manlier, I wonder...

quests.description: Manly Jack needs three servings of Mondstadt Grilled Fish.
